newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baer says 1997 starts well, looks positive.
newsitem.headline: Baer says 1997 starts well, looks positive.

text.p: Swiss banking group Julius Baer said it posted very good results in the first two months of 1997 and expected business to continue developing positively this year.
"Results in the frist two months of the current year were very good in all areas," the bank said in a statement released before a news conference.
It said the bank expected continued positive development in 1997.
Baer reported on January 31 that 1996 group net profit rose 16 percent to 133.8 million Swiss francs and assets under management jumped 29 percent to 63.6 billion Swiss francs.
